name: Cradlerespite
description: Stand with the weight split evenly as a hawk balances on two talons before a dive.

name: Radiant Cordright
description: Seat a matched pair of stones and press them with a pulse so that they leave wing to wing.

name: Shattering Slingstone
description: Swing both arms in mirrored circles and let the two cords beat the air like opened wings.

name: Hoarfrost Fingerhitch
description: Count the beat aloud so that both hands open at the very same instant.

name: Titanic Cradle
description: Send two stones on crossing lines so that they meet at the mark like wingtips closing.

name: Glint Orbit
description: Drag the second stone along the groove the first has cut in a breastplate to widen the tear.

name: Siltslung
description: Glide sideways on the balls of the feet as the pair leaves and the answering blow finds nothing.

name: Orbitruin
description: Ring the first stone off a visor to open the guard and slip the second through the slit.

name: Slingtether Devastation
description: Release mirrored pairs in a running series so that each pair lands where the one before fell short.

name: Slingscourge
description: Loose a mated pair that curve in from both flanks and strike one target in the same breath.

name: Vigilant Wristhitch
description: Read the spacing of the slingers beside you by the rhythm of their cords alone.

name: Glintslung
description: Take the whirl's tempo from the rank's leading thrower and keep to it turn for turn.

name: Shattering Leadshot
description: Open the hand on the rank's shared beat so that every stone leaves in one rush.

name: Vigilant Pouch
description: Chant a short count while reloading so that the whole rank refills in the same few breaths.

name: Intentsling
description: Draw two stones from the belt at once and seat both before the next turn begins.

name: Ponderous Singing
description: Time a pulse to the crest of the rank's wave so the front stones land together and pin the foe.

name: Gust Releasecord
description: Hold a steady rate of release across a long fight without any thrower falling out of the beat.

name: Rumble Cordleft
description: Loose a bunch of bullets at one point of a close rank so that its shields crash together.

name: Slag Slung
description: Pour stones in an unbroken stream over a wide front until the enemy can no longer advance.

name: Multiplying Cordleft
description: Stagger three ranks of volleys at rising angles so that the sky fills before the first lands.

name: Cradlehavoc
description: Draw every thrower's qi into one great release so the volley falls like a storm over the whole field.

name: Resurgent Cradle
description: Draw the second cord with the weaker hand until it moves as surely as the stronger one.

name: Energizing Wristhitch
description: Divide the count so that one track beats on the odd turns and the other on the even.

name: Pelt Devastation
description: Spin both cords in opposite circles so that neither pull can drag the other off its track.

name: Pouchwrath
description: Hold one stone a half beat so the other passes the crossing first and clears the way.

name: Hoarfrost Stonepelt
description: Throw one stone at the knees and one at the head so a single guard cannot cover both.

name: Slung Spine
description: Weave both cords round a thrusting weapon and lock it in a net the foe cannot pull free.

name: Lotcradle
description: Interleave stones from both tracks so that each opens a hole in the guard for the next.

name: Cradlevalor
description: Stretch both cords across a doorway at the end of the whirl so that the first foe through is tripped.

name: Rending Stonepelt
description: Loose both stones along tracks that bend inward and meet inside the guard at a single point.

name: Daybreak Fingerhitch
description: Draw one long breath and push it all into the single stone chosen for the throw.

name: Chimecradle
description: Search the foe's gear until the gaze rests on the one weak point the stone must reach.

name: Chime Slingstone
description: Whirl slower than the moment seems to need until the aim settles without any effort.

name: Gustpelt
description: Wait through a full extra turn after the aim feels right and release only on the next.

name: Daybreak Releasecord
description: Root both feet until not a muscle moves except the arm that turns the cord.

name: Chime Pelt
description: Send a narrow pulse of qi toward the weak point and let the stone follow its line.

name: Novapouch
description: Hold the breath and place a hard stone against the long bone behind a thin guard.

name: Radiant Pouch
description: Settle qi evenly through the stone so that its weight does not shift in flight.

name: Reverie Cordright
description: Hurl a flash-bright pebble at the face so the foe blinks at the very moment the real stone follows.

name: Facet Singing
description: Cast a slender pointed slug that finds the narrow gap beneath a raised arm and pierces deeply.

name: Ponderous Orbit
description: Pin the sword arm with one exact stone to a nerve so it cannot lift the blade.

name: Grievous Slingtether
description: Throw the chosen stone once with every ounce of gathered qi and let it find its mark.

name: Gust Leadshot
description: Sweep the cord across the front in a broad arc to knock down small thrown missiles.

name: Veritycradle
description: Count how many stones are needed to fill the space before the body at a given range.

name: Titanic Pelt
description: Open the pouch loosely so that a handful of pebbles leaves in a spreading fan at close range.

name: Healing Cordright
description: Plant the stance low and broad so that a rush of missiles cannot push the body back.

name: Cradlemettle
description: Loose a rising fan of stones before the body so that incoming missiles collide with them mid-air.

name: Facet Flingaway
description: Return a single stone along the exact line an enemy missile came down before it can be reloaded.

name: Charter Pouch
description: Throw a quick stone into the hole in the curtain at the moment a missile breaks through.

name: Flintlike Slingtether
description: Keep a ring of stones wheeling about the body that knocks aside every missile crossing its path.

name: Hour Wristhitch
description: Meet each wave of missiles with a wave of stones then step forward behind the second throw.

name: Unconquered Releasecord
description: Catch an entire enemy volley in a vast screen of stones and drive it back as one mass.

name: Mightpouch
description: Gather both cords in one smooth motion and settle both loops over the fingers.

name: Vital Slingstone
description: Cinch the spare loop at the hip so that a cord is ready the moment a hand goes empty.

name: Gust Slung
description: Whirl one cord high and one low in opposed turns so they never tangle or slow.

name: Cradle Reckoning
description: Let go with both hands in a mirrored opening so the two stones are born together.

name: Peltblink
description: Pivot on the lead foot after a double release so both cords swing to the new facing.

name: Cordleft Scourge
description: Sweep the low cord's pouch along the ground so that it takes the legs from under a rushing foe.

name: Vengeful Stonepelt
description: Lash the high cord down across the shoulder so that the stone's weight rings against the collar.

name: Fastening Leadshot
description: Cross the cords around a foe's torso and cinch them so that both his arms are pinned.

name: Blistering Cordleft
description: Loose a stone then send a second pulse after it so its echo strikes a heartbeat behind.

name: Gust Slingtether
description: Hit the head and the knees in the same instant so the foe is pinched between two blows.

name: Chime Singing
description: Hook both cords over a blade and haul it out of the hand and up into the air.

name: Silt Orbit
description: Orbit both pouches about the body and throw a stone from each on every turn at the foes around.

name: Shattering Pouch
description: Close both cords from above and below at once so one foe is crushed between the strokes.

name: Chime Releasecord
description: Mark the bearing to a far point with a chalk line on a rock before the first throw.

name: Remnant Wristhitch
description: Draw a sight line along the plateau's rim and hold it in the mind through the whirl.

name: Decimating Orbit
description: Turn the whirl so that its plane lies along the taken bearing from the first turn to the release.

name: Flingaway Scourge
description: Time the release to the last word of the bearing oath each time without fail.

name: Might Slung
description: Trim the stance by a half step when the gust drops so the line of the whirl holds.

name: Rampaging Slingstone
description: Push a pulse of qi along the held bearing so that it carries the stone straight to its end.

name: Decimating Singing
description: Offset the aim into a crossing gale by the measured drift and let the wind bring it back.

name: Tempered Fingerhitch
description: Lock the bearing to a galloping rider and loose ahead of him so that the stone takes him off the saddle.

name: Ponderous Pelt
description: Throw along three held bearings across a wide front to pin a line from end to end.

name: Ruinous Flingaway
description: Send an oath-sworn slug across a great distance to pierce one chosen shield on the far ridge.

name: Searing Leadshot
description: Keep the sworn bearing unbroken through a vast winding and let the stone fly to its very end.

name: Intent Cordright
description: Dedicate the cord to the wind with a spoken line and a thread of qi along its length.

name: Releasecord Scourge
description: Begin the whirl as a gust rises so that the pouch catches the wind's strength from the first turn.

name: Punishing Stonepelt
description: Cut the release off cleanly on the oath's final word so no drag lingers on the stone.

name: Hoarfrost Orbit
description: Raise a pulse in step with the gust so that the stone rides it upward and farther.

name: Blaze Fingerhitch
description: Lash the cord's end with the full gust behind it so a close foe is struck across the face.

name: Harnessing Cradle
description: Cast the cord's loop over a spear's head and let the wind pull it taut and wide.

name: Grievous Pouch
description: Spin a slug on the cord's twist and fling it into a gust so that it drills through mail.

name: Doctrine Cradle
description: Speak three oaths in turn and loose a stone on each so that they fly together on three winds.

name: Unsparing Pelt
description: Call down a massive stone on a gale that drops straight onto one foe with a roar.

name: Waningsling
description: Read the open ground for dips and rises that will bend a charge toward or away from the line.

name: Mangling Stonepelt
description: Take up the whirl's cadence in a thin spread line so no neighbour's cord ever crosses yours.

name: Glint Cordleft
description: Release at will inside the rank's rhythm so the stones come in a ragged shower.

name: Flingaway Glimmer
description: Sidestep after every release as a habit so that no answering stone finds the same spot twice.

name: Shattering Singing
description: Sweep a pulse across the whole line's throw to hold a distant ridge crest under fire.

name: Titanic Leadshot
description: Wheel the whole line on one end and keep the stones flowing as the flank swings round.

name: Hourcradle
description: Hammer a low wall with stones until fragments fly off and drive the men sheltering behind it out.

name: Downpour Cordright
description: Fill the horses' path with stones so that the charge stumbles and falls apart across the plain.

name: Intent Wristhitch
description: Roll the volleys from one end of the line to the other so that fire never leaves the enemy.

name: Siltsling
description: Loose the whole line's stones at once in one vast wave that tears down any barrier before it.

name: Waning Slingtether
description: Raise a wet finger to feel which side of it cools first and so find the gust's direction.

name: Slingrespite
description: Tie a thread to the cord's tail and read the gust from the angle at which it streams.

name: Radiant Fingerhitch
description: Shift the aim sideways by the amount the thread shows and ignore the mark itself.

name: Chime Stonepelt
description: Lean the whirl's plane a little into the crosswind so that the cord holds its circle.

name: Facetcradle
description: Let go between two gusts on the thrower's own breath so the stone leaves in a lull.

name: Slingstone Reckoning
description: Loose in the narrow window between gusts and add a pulse to cross it before the next one.

name: Hoarfrost Slung
description: Throw wide of the mark and let a steady crosswind curve the stone back onto it.

name: Facet Pouch
description: Cut a pocket of still air along the stone's path with a sweep of field so it flies true through a gale.

name: Peltruin
description: Skip the stone along a rock face into the gust so that it ricochets round a corner.

name: Slungruin
description: Ride a steep descending gust to drive a slug down through a roof onto a taken mark.

name: Lotsling
description: Throw three stones in a row each corrected by the drift of the one before it.

name: Tempered Slingtether
description: Loose into the heart of a gale and let the whole wind carry the stone to the mark.

name: Pouchvigil
description: Crouch on a cliff's lip with one hand on the rock so that the throw begins from stillness.

name: Might Leadshot
description: Grip the rock with the toes and settle the weight so that a sudden gust cannot lift the body.

name: Rumblesling
description: Whirl the pouch beneath a ledge's overhang in short circles that never touch the rock.

name: Illuminating Slingstone
description: Fix the aim along the plumb line from the ledge to the ground and read the lean from it.

name: Dazzling Orbit
description: Drop to the ledge below and roll to absorb the fall with the cord held clear.

name: Ferocious Fingerhitch
description: Loose steeply upward from under an overhang at a climber's head above the lip.

name: Devastating Singing
description: Leap from the lip and loose with a pulse at the top of the drop before the cliff is cleared.

name: Ponderous Releasecord
description: Pin a climber's hand against the rock with a stone so he cannot pull himself up.

name: Cradle Devastation
description: Dislodge a mass of loose stones above a ledge and send them down onto the path below.

name: Lot Cordright
description: Throw down then swing back up on the cord and throw again from the ledge above.

name: Punishing Slung
description: Hurl one massive stone down the cliff face so that everything climbing it is swept away.

name: Verity Wristhitch
description: Swear aloud to the mark with the eyes fixed upon it and let no other sight enter the mind.

name: Slungscourge
description: Whirl through a slow count of seven and let the oath ride each number.

name: Blazesling
description: Hold the releasing hand fixed in its path until the very last word has passed the lips.

name: Daybreak Cordleft
description: Sort the shot bag by weight so that each stone drawn is the same as the one before.

name: Wristhitch Respite
description: Seat a pulse of qi in the stone with the oath so it will answer to the mark.

name: Slunghavoc
description: Loose a second stone along the first one's miss as corrected by what the eye saw.

name: Pitiless Slingtether
description: Throw after a fleeing foe along the line sworn at the start so that the stone strikes his back.

name: Lotslung
description: Chain stone after stone each answering the last one's fall until the mark is struck.

name: Tempered Slung
description: Draw the oath into a thin lance of qi about the bullet and thrust it through a shield.

name: Glintpouch
description: Complete the sworn throw in one great release so that the stone arrives as the oath is ended.
